The Indian Express Investigation | An eight-year delay. Five troubled project packages. A cost escalation of over ₹5,500 crore.
Why is the Mumbai-Goa highway still incomplete, nearly two decades after the project was conceived?
In this Indian Express investigation, Dheeraj Mishra tracks the contractors behind five delayed packages on the Maharashtra stretch of National Highway 66. The investigation examines companies that defaulted on bank loans, entered insolvency proceedings, faced contract termination and had links to businessmen and politicians.
